sheets.noticed: Cream background, a yellow 840 tile pops in under 'Last quarter we got'. The big number is the hook. Still in.
SUPPORT TICKETS label under the 840, then LOGIN PROBLEMS slides in large in orange. Bold and readable. Still in.
A yellow 412 tile builds up for login with an ALMOST HALF label. The tiles read like a chart forming. Still in.
A 268 billing tile sits next to the login tile, so it starts to look like a comparison. Still in.
Holds still on 412 and 268 while the voice asks about everything else. A bit static, but the question pulls me. Still in.
'Shipping + other = ?' then 97 and 63 tiles drop in and it reads just 160. The reveal lands. Still in.
Shipping and other get struck through, 160 sits above them, and FIX LOGIN appears in orange. Clear payoff. Still in.
HALF OF ALL TICKETS label and 'Fix login: half the queue goes away'. Frames are holding still now, but the point has landed. Still in.
Nothing moves and there is no new narration, just the end card sitting there. I would thumb past it.

remembers: Last quarter we got 840 support tickets: login problems were 412, almost half, billing 268, and everything else only 160. Fixing login would take out about half the queue.
